title: 自动生成可审查晋升提案，而不是自动升格知识
summary: Intake 自动化应把事实整理成可审查 Proposal：建议记录类型、低成熟度状态、provenance、可能重复项和证据强度；真正落成 typed record 需要显式 accept/reject，且自动路径不得越过 observed/candidate。
principles: Evidence packets remain immutable after collection.
Proposal generation is deterministic and repeatable from packet plus triage state.
Duplicate candidates are suggestions, not automatic merges.
Automatic proposals may suggest only observed or candidate maturity.
Acceptance creates a typed intake record, not Canonical knowledge.
Rejected proposals remain auditable through a review ledger.
